Subject: Delta to quota — trench map & owner pacts

Team —

Short and tactical: finance wants a clear trench map for next 10 business days outlining exactly where we'll pick up the remaining $1.8M to hit Q4 target. I attached an updated delta_heatmap_v3.xlsx with expected conversion cadence and a proposed "owner pacts" template. Ask list: 

1) Each owner (cc'd) — update your top 8 opportunities in the sheet with: realistic close date, committed amount, next milestone, blockers, and the step that converts this from "at-risk" -> "commit". Use conservative close probabilities (we'll use these for week-over-week run rate).
2) Mark any deal that requires an exec exception (discount > 25% / SLA exception / legal redlines) and add the short justification in the comments column.
3) Please update HubSpot (deal stages) to reflect the changes by EOD Wed 11/11 PT. Finance will run a reconciliation on Thu 11/12.

I'm explicitly asking for owner pledges (one-line) in reply to this thread when you've updated the sheet — who will move to "commit" and what the gating item is. We'll do a 15-min stand at 11/11 10:30 PT if needed.

Why this matters: we have a delta to quota that's concentrated in a handful of mid-market accounts; if we can't convert 45% of the mid-market funnel in the next two weeks we need to trigger contingency (reserve list + alternative ARR).

Attachments: delta_heatmap_v3.xlsx, owner_pacts_template.docx

— Hannah
